text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Grrraaar! Outta my way! Nobody runs<n>in front of
Windy!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rwaaar! I said get outta the way or<n>I'mma bite—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (NO!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (I promised I'd never do that again!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... That was too close...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Shinko Windy ran an honest<n>race today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's running with so much more<n>power and
fluidity compared to her<n>debut race. Her training has
started to<n>bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe! ♪ Told ya, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: There ain't nothin' I can't do when I<n>actually try!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or did the other athletes<n>seem a little...
off? Like they were all<n>running scared?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I noticed that too. If you ask me,<n>that's
probably the only reason she<n>did so well...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hey, I know I'd be watching my backif I thought someone was going tobite me! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Mngh! Are you kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Very true... Wait a second. Didn't she<n>look like she
was about to bite<n>someone coming around that last
corner?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no I wasn't!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I didn't bite her, did I?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though Shinko Windy ran really<n>well, the
spectators appear<n>preoccupied with other things...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Man, I wanted to see Windy chomp<n>someone! I
know it's against the<n>rules and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to see something crazy,<n>too! That's
her whole appeal, isn't it?<n>Bwahaha!
choice_data_list: (They're not seeing how well she ran...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nnngh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like everyone's impressions<n>of her are still
colored by her past<n>incident, but she's definitely
come a<n>long way since then.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You sure? The people in the stands<n>don't seem to
think so. All I heard<n>from 'em was stupid laughter.
choice_data_list: I think your training has really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I controlled myself all the way<n>to the finish
line and didn't bite<n>anyone.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll make them understand<n>for sure—I'm
not gonna bite anyone<n>ever again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Can't wait to shut 'em all up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to clean up her<n>reputation, she'll need
to take on a<n>bigger challenge and come out on top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Higher-graded races are guaranteed<n>to have
first-rate competition. Win<n>enough of them, and no
one will be<n>able to claim it was a fluke again.
choice_data_list: Should we jump straight into a G1?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Win one of those and everyone will<n>see that I'm
amazing, won't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Based on our schedule, the Japan<n>Dirt Derby
seems to be the best<n>option. I suggest it to her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: 'Nough said! I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
After I win, no one's gonna be callin'<n>me a coward
or a thug again! This<n>bad reputation's ticked me off
for the<n>last time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll put it in the past and make a new<n>name for
myself as the biggest<n>bad—Wicked Windy!
